promptSummary: Three coordinated top-down wearable accessories matching the painted hand and pastel salon: a delicate pearl bracelet revised to pearls plus a small heart charm with no bow, a bold gold heart ring with a 12–15% band and larger gem, and a petite pink wrist bow; soft painted realism, warm upper-left lighting, isolated transparent objects, no text or logos. Three variants (A–C) were generated.
processing: Alpha-cropped each generated sheet third, selected C, fitted without distortion, split each top-down oval at its centre into a rear arc and a front arc/centrepiece, and encoded lossless WebP. The ring revision fills its runtime box so the painted band keeps its required small-screen stroke weight.

revisionPrompts.pearl-bracelet-no-bow-source.png: Precise edit of selected bracelet: remove the bow, tails, and side beads; reconstruct a continuous oval pearl strand with one small centred gold-framed pink heart charm; preserve painted style and lighting.
revisionPrompts.heart-ring-bold-source.png: Precise edit of selected ring: preserve outer width and top-down wrap, increase gold band thickness to about 13% of outer width, and enlarge the centred faceted pink heart beyond the band thickness.

prompts.friendship-thread-bracelet: Thick softly braided pastel friendship-thread oval with a short row of large round beads.

moreAccessories.sharedPrompt: Top-down complete oval wearable in the existing glossy pastel painted style; warm upper-left highlights; broad child-friendly rounded forms; full uninterrupted oval suitable for rear/front layer splitting; no text, hands, sharp points, shadows, logos, or floating pieces.
moreAccessories.processing: Alpha-crop each generated source, fit to a 640x440 runtime canvas, split at 45% into rear and front arcs, measure the widest visible front row, encode lossless front/back WebPs, and build a separate 384px tray icon. Runtime divides the measured limb width by that visible-span fraction.
